2610.06744.title: ufakzeka-karar: An Open Turkish Typed-Decision Model with Order-Invariant Option Scoring
2610.06744.paper_summary: ufakzeka-karar is an open Turkish decision model with 182,494,466 parameters. Given a Turkish text and questions of a fixed answer type (a choice, a level on an ordered scale, or yes or no), it returns a temperature-scaled probability for every option and an expected error that serves as a "not sure" signal, without generating text and in one CPU forward pass for up to ten options. Built on the lab's ufakzeka-1-base, its head scores each option blind to the others at shared positions, so the answer does not depend on option order. A sequential head trained with shuffled options was about as accurate but changed 2.3 to 2.8 percent of its answers when only the option order changed; REINFORCE lost 10.2 points (0.102) of macro F1 to cross-entropy. On the open set of HakemBench v1.0 (4,275 questions, 7 tracks) the released model ranks 7th of 16 rows with a composite of 0.660 (95% interval 0.642 to 0.677). Temperature scaling lowers calibration error (smooth ECE) on the development set but raises it on held-out support questions, from 0.027 to 0.045 for the first scored run, which never trained on them; the released model later trained on them, so its 0.036 to 0.064 is not an unseen-question test. The released model is the last of three runs scored on HakemBench, and its numbers are not blind. The second run's new training data was aimed at the first run's errors on the full test set in guardrails, moderation and customer support, and the released run was trained after the second run's guardrail results on the full test set were read, under a protocol fixed in writing before any of its data, code or runs. All its numbers come after these readings; its guardrail, moderation and customer support numbers carry the flag "shaped by reading the test results". With every model scored on the other four tracks only, its composite is 0.678, 6th of 16. Weights and code are under Apache-2.0.
2610.06744.paper_summary_zh: ufakzeka-karar 是一個開放的土耳其決策模型，擁有 182,494,466 個參數。給定一段土耳其文本和固定答案類型的問題（選擇、一個有序尺度上的水平，或是是或否），它為每個選項返回一個經過溫度縮放的概率和一個作為「不確定」信號的預期誤差，無需生成文本，並且在一次 CPU 前向傳遞中處理最多十個選項。該模型基於實驗室的 ufakzeka-1-base，其頭部在共享位置上對每個選項進行盲評，因此答案不依賴於選項的順序。用隨機選項訓練的序列頭的準確性大致相當，但在僅改變選項順序時，其答案變更了 2.3% 到 2.8%；REINFORCE 在交叉熵上損失了 10.2 分（0.102）的宏 F1。在 HakemBench v1.0 的開放集（4,275 個問題，7 條軌道）中，發布的模型在 16 行中排名第 7，綜合得分為 0.660（95% 區間 0.642 到 0.677）。溫度縮放降低了開發集上的校準誤差（平滑的 ECE），但在保留的支持問題上提高了誤差，第一次計分運行從 0.027 增加到 0.045，該運行從未在這些問題上進行過訓練；發布的模型後來在這些問題上進行了訓練，因此其 0.036 到 0.064 不是未見問題的測試。發布的模型是三次在 HakemBench 上計分的運行中的最後一次，其數據不是盲目的。第二次運行的新訓練數據針對第一次運行在完整測試集中的錯誤，涉及防護、審核和客戶支持，而發布的運行是在第二次運行的防護結果在完整測試集上讀取後進行訓練的，遵循在其數據、代碼或運行之前以書面形式固定的協議。所有數據均來自這些讀取；其防護、審核和客戶支持數據標記為「受到測試結果閱讀影響」。在僅對其他四條軌道進行計分的每個模型中，其綜合得分為 0.678，排名第 6。權重和代碼遵循 Apache-2.0 許可證。
